## Sets

- $x \in A$: $x$ is an element of $A$.
- $\emptyset$ is the empty set,
  and $\card{A}$ is the number of elements of a finite set $A$.
- $A \subseteq B$ if every element of $A$ is an element of $B$.
- $A = B$ if $A \subseteq B$ and $B \subseteq A$.
- $A \cup B = \set{x : x \in A \lor x \in B}$ and $A \cap B = \set{x : x \in A \land x \in B}$.
- $A - B = \set{x : x \in A \land x \notin B}$.
- $\powerset{A}$, the *power set* of $A$, is the set of all subsets of $A$.
- $A \times B = \set{(a, b) : a \in A \land b \in B}$, the set of ordered pairs.
